announcements.title: StegZ 1.4 for Windows
announcements.message:
• Credits to Havenova X in Settings (click to visit)
• "Don't show this again" on announcements
• Ad banner support under the toolbar
• Text editor, archive previews and instant archive opening
Tip: press F1 for the Help guide.

announcements.title: StegZ for Android 1.4
announcements.message:
• Default save folder: Downloads/StegZ - change it any time in Settings
• Save-to choice in Hide/Extract is one-time and returns to your Settings folder
• Task progress in the status bar, with notification permission
• Run-in-background (battery unrestricted) and a permissions checklist
• Files tab remembers your folder - Back no longer reloads from the start
• Credits: Made by Havenova X (havenovax.name.ng)
